content.objective: 구현·테스트·영향 문서 갱신 역할을 분리하고 Documentation Agent를 필수 백그라운드 Goal로 실행한다.
content.targetTestRole: test-only; must not modify code; runs only exact Human-requested tests
content.targetDocumentationRole: affected-document-only; must not modify code or unrelated documents; must use owning managers for canonical documents
content.testDefault: disabled; do not launch Test Agent when the Human requested no tests
content.documentationExecution: mandatory separate background Goal after implementation completion
content.handoff: Workflow Agent implementation result -> authorized Test Agent result or tests not run -> background Documentation Agent result -> Main Agent Human review
